How Your Move Works

Four simple steps, one phone call to start.

  1. 1

    Call or WhatsApp

    Tell us what you are moving and where. We answer 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

  2. 2

    Free survey & fixed quote

    We check your furniture — in person or by photos and video — and give you one clear price before moving day.

  3. 3

    Packing & moving day

    Our crew wraps, dismantles, loads and transports everything with care, room by room and piece by piece.

  4. 4

    Setup at your new place

    We unload, rebuild beds and wardrobes, and place the furniture where you want it. You settle in the same day.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers before you book.

How much does house shifting in Riyadh cost?

It depends on the size of your home, the amount of furniture and the distance. Send us photos or a short video of your furniture on WhatsApp, or book a free survey — we give you one fixed price before moving day, with no surprises.

Do you dismantle and rebuild beds and wardrobes?

Yes. Our carpenters dismantle beds, wardrobes and other large furniture before the move and rebuild them at your new home, as part of the service.

Can you move on Fridays or at night?

Yes — we are open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including Fridays and public holidays. Night and early-morning moves are common for offices and compounds.

Do you move to other cities in Saudi Arabia?

Yes. We move door to door between Riyadh and Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Makkah, Madinah and all other cities in the Kingdom.

How early should I book?

Two or three days ahead is ideal, especially at month-end, but same-day and next-day moves are often possible — call us and we will do our best.
